title: Help Center
dashboard_q1: How do I read the dashboard KPIs?
dashboard_a1: The dashboard shows your fleet availability rate, active alerts by severity, and current month costs in real time. Click any metric to drill down.
dashboard_a2: Your dashboard fills up once you add your first vehicle and open your first shift. Follow the getting started guide visible on the page.
dashboard_q3: How do I resolve an alert from the dashboard?
dashboard_a3: Each alert shows a direct action button (Schedule, Immobilize, Book depending on type). Click it to resolve in 1 click without leaving the page.
fleet_q1: How do I add a vehicle?
fleet_a1: Click '+ Vehicle' at the top of the Fleet page. Fill in the license plate, make, model and current mileage. You can add a photo and documents later.
fleet_q2: How do I change a vehicle's status?
fleet_a2: Open the vehicle profile (click the card or ⌘K then plate) and use the status selector in the top right: Active / In maintenance / Inactive.
fleet_q3: How do I print a vehicle QR code?
fleet_a3: From the vehicle profile, click 'Generate QR code'. A print-ready 300 DPI PDF is downloaded. Laminate it and stick it on the vehicle dashboard for instant field access.
creneau_q1: How do I open a shift?
creneau_a1: From the mobile app, tap 'Open a shift', verify the assigned vehicle, enter the starting mileage and confirm. The mission starts immediately and is visible to the manager.
creneau_q2: How do I close a shift without a connection?
creneau_a2: E-Samba works offline. The closure is queued and synced automatically when connectivity returns. An orange banner shows the number of pending actions.
maintenance_a1: From the vehicle profile, click 'Schedule maintenance'. Choose the type (oil change, service, tyres…), planned date, service provider and estimated budget in XAF.
reports_q1: How do I generate a monthly report?
reports_a1: Reports page > choose the period > click 'Generate'. The report includes fleet KPIs, per-vehicle breakdown, XAF costs and optimization recommendations.
offline_a1: Offline: viewing recently accessed vehicle profiles, opening/closing shifts, logging fuel fill-ups, reporting incidents. These sync automatically when back online.
